Intro: Hello again, friend! How has your business been? My work has had me all across Verehn recently.
I'm sure you can understand how tired you can get from being on your feet all day. Nothing like a little indulgence to bring this stressful day to a close.
If you can be a dear, friend, I am craving some [DISH].
Success: Ah, yes. Truly the best way to end the day. Thank you, friend. I'll be off now, and I'll spread the word.
Fail: …Well… it is at least agreeable…. Thanks, friend. I'll be off now.
Reject: Tch, what is with this sudden change of heart? I thought we were comrades, friend. It's alright. I'm sure my dear friend will have something to say.
